thread:
lina_onboard: PSA from today's customer PoC: sample apps and SDK disagree on env var precedence and live rotation handling.

maria_sdk: quick details?

lina_onboard: we mount k8s projected secret and update it for rotation. CLI-based deploy scripts pick the new key immediately, but long-running Node/Python samples kept using old key and hit 401s.

tom_ops: how are sample apps reading keys today?
lina_onboard: some use REDWOOD_API_KEY, others still check REDWOOD_LEGACY_KEY. Worse, both SDKs cache at import time, so they never see updated env or mounted file.

maria_sdk: agreed this is an oversight. Plan: normalize to prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY (project scoped), fall back to legacy for backcompat. Avoid import-time caching; use a short TTL lazy getter or file watch.

jules_docs: I'll add a clear precedence table in onboarding and a rotation troubleshooting checklist (how to enable refresh, how to validate projected secrets).

infra-bot: NOTE: existing feature REDWOOD_ENABLE_CRED_REFRESH available but default false for older sample images.

maria_sdk: propose enabling the credential refresh by default in sample images and adding an e2e that simulates rotation (fast fake file replace). Also add a migration note about deprecating REDWOOD_LEGACY_KEY.

lina_onboard: thanks. I'll file a support follow-up and include the logs we captured.

infra-bot: Created issue CI-9992 "sdk: env var precedence and live secret rotation support" assigned to maria_sdk.
